runtime.backend: ggml CPU only with GGML_NATIVE and OpenMP

external_evidence.transfer_warning: Neither GPU nor Apple Silicon performance is evidence of AMD Milan CPU performance. The local paired gate is authoritative.

hypothesis: A 2B Q4_K_M DFlash2 block drafter can use its approximately five-token mean acceptance to amortize Qwen3.8-27B target verification on AMD CPU more effectively than the existing one-layer MTP3 sidecar. If the eight-token target verification path is not yet efficient, acceptance and phase timing will identify an n=8 Q4_K kernel target with more leverage than further n=4-only tuning.
controls: autoregressive target-only on the exact same PR binary and target GGUF
official MTP sidecar at frozen best width 3 on the exact same PR binary and target GGUF
DFlash2 Q4_K_M sidecar with seven proposed tokens on the exact same PR binary and target GGUF

decision_rules.promote: All infrastructure and deterministic parity checks pass, DFlash2 is at least 1.65x target-only, at least 1.05x MTP3, at least 3.75 accepted tok/s, and capability tripwires pass.
decision_rules.retain_for_n8_kernel_work: All correctness checks pass, DFlash2 is at least 1.40x target-only, mean committed tokens per target call is at least 4.0, but one or more promotion throughput gates fail.
decision_rules.reject: Any infrastructure or parity check fails, or DFlash2 is below 1.40x target-only, or it fails to outperform MTP3 without phase evidence of a removable n=8 target-verification bottleneck.

required_receipts: source and binary revisions and hashes
target verification call count and mean committed tokens per target call
CUTE plus MATH/code tripwire receipts when admitted
stop_rules: Do not download BF16 or Q8 drafts before Q4_K_M passes the isolated AMD feasibility gate.
Do not port the v21 n=4 kernel into the PR before measuring the stock PR baseline.
Do not interpret the public H200 or M5 Pro numbers as expected AMD performance.
Do not claim a quality improvement: speculative verification is intended to preserve the target distribution.
Do not claim 100 tok/s or final-node scaling from this four-core feasibility node.
promotion_boundary: A pass establishes a practical lossless speculative-decoding direction for Qwen3.8-27B on this AMD CPU and a basis for n=8 kernel work. It does not establish conventional autoregressive 2.75 tok/s, 100 tok/s, final-node scaling, or algorithmic novelty.
